assignmentHtml.task: Research Like Nastya YouTube channel comprehensively. Find: (1) Stable channel ID and canonical URL. (2) Operator: Nastya and her parents (Sergey and Julia). Company structure. (3) Channel creation date and earliest still-public upload. (4) Operating location and displayed country. (5) Languages. (6) Primary content category. (7) Content supply model. (8) Representative series. Provide direct source URLs.
assignmentHtml.context: Like Nastya is #9 with ~123B lifetime views per Communitrics snapshot dated September 2, 2026. Need verifiable facts with source links. The operator family may be Ukrainian or Russian - need to verify nationality from public sources.
assignmentHtml.expected_output: A structured dossier for Like Nastya with all requested fields, each with source URLs.

answerHtml:
Like Nastya YouTube Channel Dossier

1. Channel ID and Canonical URL

  • Channel ID: UCJplp5SjeGSdVdwsfb9Q7lQ
  • Canonical URL: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCJplp5SjeGSdVdwsfb9Q7lQ
  • Handle/alternate URL: https://www.youtube.com/@LikeNastyaofficial
    Source: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCJplp5SjeGSdVdwsfb9Q7lQ and https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Like_Nastya

2. Operator and Company Structure

  • Operator: Anastasia Radzinskaya (online as 'Like Nastya') with parents Sergey and Anna Radzinskaya.
  • IMPORTANT CORRECTION: The mother is Anna, not 'Julia' as stated in the orchestrator context. Multiple sources consistently identify the mother as Anna (@annaradzinskaya on Instagram).
  • Father's name: Sergey (confirmed by Wikipedia, RBTH, Valero Enterprises, Famous Birthdays, and Dubdb's patronymic 'Sergeyevna'). Some older Tubefilter/Business Insider articles use 'Yuri,' but the weight of evidence supports Sergey.
  • Company structure: Family-run operation with ~20 dedicated employees (as of 2020). Parents sold businesses in Russia in 2015 to pursue YouTube full-time. Management handled through Los Angeles-based multi-channel network Yoola (signed ~2017–2018), with brand representation by WME/IMG (both Endeavor subsidiaries). Operational team consists of Nastya, both parents, and two video editors alongside Yoola's support.
    Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Like_Nastya, https://www.businessinsider.com/youtube-channel-like-nastya-stacy-toys-business-yoola-2020-2, https://www.rbth.com/lifestyle/331499-meet-most-popular-russian-youtuber, https://valeroenterprises.com/portfolio/like-nastya/

3. Channel Creation Date and Earliest Still-Public Upload

  • Channel creation: December 6, 2016 (Social Blade record). First video published: December 14, 2016.
  • Note: An earlier video was posted on January 25, 2016 (two days before Nastya's 2nd birthday) but on the predecessor channel 'Like Nastya Vlog' (joined January 14, 2016), which was renamed to 'Like Nastya' around 2020.
  • Earliest still-public upload on the current main channel: December 14, 2016. Exact title unconfirmed due to inability to directly access YouTube's sorted video list (CAPTCHA-blocked).
    Sources: https://socialblade.com/youtube/handle/likenastyaofficial, https://www.thoughtleaders.io/blog/how-much-money-do-kid-youtubers-make, https://www.straitstimes.com/world/europe/how-a-6-year-old-russian-girl-became-youtubes-most-popular-child-star, https://youtube.fandom.com/wiki/Like_Nastya

4. Operating Location and Displayed Country

  • Operating location: Miami, Florida, USA (family relocated in 2018; some earlier sources cite Boca Raton, FL — likely moved between these South Florida cities).
  • Displayed country: United States.
    Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Like_Nastya, https://www.tubefilter.com/2020/03/20/nastya-radzinskaya-50-million-subscribers-3-8-billion-views/, https://valeroenterprises.com/portfolio/like-nastya/

5. Languages

  • Primary language: Russian
  • Channels dubbed into: English, German, Arabic, Bangla, French, Portuguese, Hindi, Turkish, Spanish, Korean, Vietnamese, Indonesian (12 languages total).
    Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Like_Nastya, https://dubdb.fandom.com/wiki/Like_Nastya

6. Primary Content Category

  • Children's entertainment spanning toy unboxing, vlogs, educational entertainment, roleplays, and nursery rhymes. Officially tagged as Comedy, Educational, and Unboxing/Product Review.
    Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Like_Nastya, https://www.pluggedin.com/youtube-reviews/like-nastya/

7. Content Supply Model

  • Original family-produced content: parents write scripts, coordinate filming, and edit. Anna serves as de facto videographer/scriptwriter; Sergey co-stars in most videos. ~20 employees handle editing, translation, and distribution. High production value (~$1,000–$2,000 per video). Content repurposed across 8+ localized channels. Managed via Yoola MCN for monetization, licensing, and brand deals.
    Sources: https://www.businessinsider.com/youtube-channel-like-nastya-stacy-toys-business-yoola-2020-2, https://www.rbth.com/lifestyle/331499-meet-most-popular-russian-youtuber, https://www.tubefilter.com/2020/03/20/nastya-radzinskaya-50-million-subscribers-3-8-billion-views/

8. Representative Series

  • 'Nastya and papa/Dad' (recurring father-daughter adventure format; most popular video: 'Nastya and Papa Sleeping at Farm Sheep Family Fun Trip' with ~935M+ views)
  • 'Like Nastya Show' (subsidiary channel, 44.3M subscribers)
  • 'Like Nastya Collections' (compilation channel)
  • 'Playgrounds for kids from Like Nastya' (playlist series)
  • 'Like Nastya Travel' (playlist series)
  • 'Learn Like Nastya' (educational app and subsidiary channel)
    Sources: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCJplp5SjeGSdVdwsfb9Q7lQ, https://www.thoughtleaders.io/blog/how-much-money-do-kid-youtubers-make, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Like_Nastya
